children: Azamat Yerdessov, an officer serving as Freedom Life Chief Exec. Ofc., reported two direct sales of Freedom Holding common stock on 2026-08-28. The transactions comprised 1,500 shares sold at $175.00 and 1,500 shares sold at $171.60, for a weighted average price of $173.30 per share. The total reported sale amount was $519,900. Following the reported transactions, Yerdessov directly owned 224,442 common shares.
